summary.en: V4 Pro for complex code and mathematics; Flash for efficient everyday execution.
summary.zh: V4 Pro 面向复杂代码与数学推理，Flash 面向高性价比日常执行。

title.en: DeepSeek V4 Pro vs V4.1 Flash: Models, Features and Use Cases
title.zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro 与 V4.1 Flash：模型区别、能力与用途

description.en: Compare DeepSeek V4 Pro and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash for coding, mathematical reasoning, response speed, throughput, model IDs, and common use cases.
description.zh: 对比 DeepSeek V4 Pro 与 V4.1 Flash 的编程、数理推理、响应速度、吞吐、Model ID 与适用场景。

keywords.zh: DeepSeek Pro 和 Flash 对比

title.en: DeepSeek V4 Pro vs V4.1 Flash.
title.zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro 与 V4.1 Flash 对比。

description.en: Select DeepSeek V4 Pro for difficult code and mathematical reasoning. Move routine coding and general work to DeepSeek Flash when efficiency matters more.
description.zh: 复杂代码与数理推理选择 DeepSeek V4 Pro；常规编程和通用任务在更重视效率时选择 DeepSeek Flash。

title.en: A practical split between hard reasoning and fast throughput.
title.zh: 在高难度推理与快速吞吐之间做务实分工。

description.en: DeepSeek is useful when the team wants to reserve deeper reasoning for algorithms and difficult logic while keeping routine work economical.
description.zh: 当团队希望把深度推理留给算法与困难逻辑，同时让常规任务保持高性价比时，DeepSeek 很合适。

description.en: Suited to algorithms, mathematics, and failures driven by wrong assumptions.
description.zh: 适合算法、数学及由错误假设引发的疑难问题。

description.en: Better for edits, explanations, and repeated requests.
description.zh: 更适合修改、解释和重复请求。

description.en: Do not pay the reasoning cost when the task is already clear.
description.zh: 任务已经明确时，不必额外承担深度推理成本。

description.en: The family is positioned around difficult textual and mathematical work.
description.zh: 该系列重点面向复杂文本与数理任务。

title.en: Two DeepSeek lanes for two cost profiles.
title.zh: 两条 DeepSeek 路径，对应两种成本结构。

description.en: Choose based on how much reasoning the task deserves.
description.zh: 根据任务真正需要的推理量来选择。

description.en: Complex coding, algorithms, and mathematical reasoning.
description.zh: 复杂编程、算法与数理推理。

description.en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash for efficient coding and general requests.
description.zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，适合高性价比编程与通用请求。

title.en: Match the reasoning budget to the failure risk.
title.zh: 让推理投入与失败风险匹配。

description.en: The Pro and Flash variants should not receive identical work by default.
description.zh: Pro 与 Flash 不应默认承担完全相同的工作。

brief.en: Design an approach with correctness and complexity constraints.
brief.zh: 在正确性与复杂度约束下设计方案。

process.en: V4 Pro can examine assumptions, edge cases, and the proof behind the implementation.
process.zh: V4 Pro 可检查假设、边界条件与实现背后的论证。

outcome.en: An implementable algorithm with explicit reasoning.
outcome.zh: 一套论证明确、可以实现的算法方案。

brief.en: Trace a calculation that fails only under particular inputs.
brief.zh: 追踪仅在特定输入下失败的计算。

process.en: V4 Pro follows the mathematical path instead of patching the final symptom.
process.zh: V4 Pro 沿数学过程追踪，而不是只修补最终症状。

outcome.en: A fix tied to the actual invalid assumption.
outcome.zh: 针对真实错误假设的修复。

brief.en: Complete several small, clearly specified code or text changes.
brief.zh: 完成多项边界清楚的小型代码或文本修改。

process.en: Flash favors quick turns where extensive deliberation would add little value.
process.zh: Flash 优先快速周转，避免无必要的深度思考。

outcome.en: More completed routine work with less waiting.
outcome.zh: 以更少等待完成更多常规任务。

title.en: Two selectable models, each with a clear job.
title.zh: 两个可直接选择的型号，各自承担明确工作。

description.en: Both models are managed by Floatboat; the distinction is the amount of reasoning the task deserves.
description.zh: 两个型号均由 Floatboat 托管，区别在于任务值得投入多少推理。

description.en: V4 Pro addresses algorithms, difficult logic, and failure analysis.
description.zh: V4 Pro 处理算法、困难逻辑与故障分析。

description.en: Use Pro where correctness depends on following quantitative relationships.
description.zh: 当正确性取决于数理关系时使用 Pro。

description.en: V4.1 Flash handles lightweight coding and general requests efficiently.
description.zh: V4.1 Flash 高效处理轻量编程与通用请求。

description.en: The standard `deepseek-flash` ID maps to the V4.1 Flash client alias.
description.zh: 标准 ID `deepseek-flash` 对应 V4.1 Flash 客户端别名。

title.en: Do not choose Pro merely because it is the larger option.
title.zh: 不要仅因为 Pro 规格更高就默认选择它。

items.en: The task contains genuine algorithmic or mathematical uncertainty.
items.zh: 任务确实包含算法或数学上的不确定性。

items.en: A mistaken assumption can invalidate the entire implementation.
items.zh: 错误假设可能使整个实现失效。

items.en: You need to explain why the solution is correct, not only produce it.
items.zh: 你不仅需要答案，还需要解释它为何成立。

title.en: Choose Flash or another route when
title.zh: 这些情况改选 Flash 或其他路径

items.en: The requested change is routine and tightly scoped.
Throughput and response time define success.
items.zh: 吞吐与响应时间决定任务成败。

items.en: The task is dominated by very large multimodal input; consider Gemini Pro.
items.zh: 任务主要受超大规模多模态输入影响，可考虑 Gemini Pro。

title.en: Escalate only when the problem earns it.
title.zh: 只有问题值得时，才升级推理强度。

description.en: Use for algorithm design, difficult failures, and work where a wrong assumption compounds.
description.zh: 用于算法设计、疑难故障，以及错误假设会持续放大的任务。

description.en: Use for common edits, explanations, and repeatable tasks where throughput dominates.
description.zh: 用于常规修改、解释和吞吐优先的重复任务。

question.en: Are `deepseek-flash` and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash the same listing?
question.zh: `deepseek-flash` 与 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 是同一项吗？

answer.en: Yes. `deepseek-flash` is the standard model ID and `deepseek-v4.1-flash` is its client alias. It replaces the retired `deepseek-v4-flash`.
answer.zh: 是。`deepseek-flash` 是标准 Model ID，`deepseek-v4.1-flash` 是客户端别名，并已替代退役的 `deepseek-v4-flash`。

question.zh: 什么时候值得选择 Pro？

answer.en: Choose Pro when the task has genuinely difficult reasoning, algorithmic, or mathematical failure modes—not simply because it is the larger option.
answer.zh: 当任务确实存在高难度推理、算法或数学错误风险时选择 Pro，而不是仅因为它规格更高。

question.en: When should I choose DeepSeek Flash?
question.zh: 什么时候应该选择 DeepSeek Flash？

answer.en: Choose Flash for routine code changes, explanations, lightweight questions, and repeated work where response speed and throughput matter most.
answer.zh: 常规代码修改、解释、轻量问答以及更看重响应速度和吞吐的重复任务适合选择 Flash。

question.en: What are the DeepSeek V4 Pro and Flash model IDs?
question.zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro 与 Flash 的 Model ID 是什么？

answer.en: The standard IDs are `deepseek-v4-pro` and `deepseek-flash`; the Flash client alias is `deepseek-v4.1-flash`.
answer.zh: 标准 ID 分别为 `deepseek-v4-pro` 与 `deepseek-flash`；Flash 的客户端别名是 `deepseek-v4.1-flash`。

question.en: Is DeepSeek V4 Pro good for mathematical reasoning?
question.zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro 适合数理推理吗？

answer.en: Yes. Its confirmed positioning includes complex mathematical, algorithmic, and logical reasoning where a wrong assumption can invalidate the solution.
answer.zh: 适合。其已确认定位包括复杂数学、算法与逻辑推理，尤其适用于错误假设可能使方案失效的任务。

title.en: Reserve Pro for the problems that need Pro.
title.zh: 把 Pro 留给真正需要 Pro 的问题。

description.en: Switch between depth and efficiency without moving the project or rebuilding its context.
description.zh: 在不迁移项目、不重建上下文的前提下切换深度与效率。
